schema.coordinateSystem: block-center; +X right, +Y up, +Z south; unit is one block
schema.triangles: meshes[].vertices is flat XYZ triples, three vertices per triangle; uv and normals use the same order
schema.textures: textures entries are atlas-compatible {file,width,height,frames,frameTime}; file is relative to src/assets/factory3d
schema.deviceMapping: models[id].meshes names shared entries in meshes
schema.modelKinds: solid devices use kind=custom; the aura node uses kind=effect
schema.billboards: billboard meshes use camera-facing vertices; uv origin is top-left and atlas frame/layer are runtime inputs
schema.bounds: real model bounds are retained when source geometry exceeds the nominal one-block box

source.modelPose: static default: bore base/nozzle and emitter, assembler render at -0.1 angle, scrubber tip at -0.075
